title: Fix 2 Dangling Workspace Dependencies Blocking Bun Install
description: Fix dangling workspace:* dependency declarations for @semio-tech/animate-present-core and @semio-tech/puzzle-2d-rs blocking bun install repo-wide.
summary:
1. Removed dead workspace dependency `@semio-tech/animate-present-core`: "workspace:*" from `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/package.json` (@semio-tech/animate-js) and `♻️mit-bestand/🎤️präsentation/📅️33.projektetage/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/package.json` (@semio-tech/mit-bestand-praesentation-projektetage).
2. Removed dead workspace dependency `@semio-tech/puzzle-2d-rs`: "workspace:*" from `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/📺️renderer/🧑️🎨️engine/📦️packages/🟦️typescript/🎯️targets/⚛️react/package.json` (@semio-tech/framework-renderer-react), where board-2d rendering already routes via `@semio-tech/framework-surface-board-2d-rs`.
3. Executed unsandboxed `bun install` at repo root — confirmed lockfile regenerated and `bun install` completed cleanly (135 packages installed, 0 errors).
